title: SenseTime AI Office Agent Xiao Huanxiong Mobile Version Released: Send Instructions via Phone, Computer Continuously Executes

content_html:
SenseTime announced the official launch of the mobile app for its AI office intelligent agent "Xiaohuahan", available for Apple iOS and Android. Users who submit an app feedback questionnaire can earn 1000 points.

The official stated that the mobile version of "Xiaohuahan" supports natural voice interaction for quick dialogue operations: users can long-press to speak their requests and release to send, allowing them to view, share, and continue their work even when away from their desk, achieving "issue commands from your phone, and have the computer execute continuously".

According to public information, SenseTime's AI office intelligent agent "Xiaohuahan" is equipped with a "multimodal intelligent agent creation engine", which can understand and organize user's fragmented information, and also has the ability for "long-chain thinking" and the integration of internal and external enterprise information.
